channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Taiwan blocks Grab's $600 million Foodpanda deal over Uber stake
item.description: The decision ends, for now, Grab's first attempt to expand outside Southeast Asia.

item.title: Bono addresses U2 ticket prices for new tour
item.description: The U2 frontman says the band has little control over ticket costs. His comments come as presales open for its 2027 world tour.

item.title: Investors still back AI despite growing doubts
item.description: Also: All the news and watercooler chat from Fortune.

item.title: Jeff Bezos reportedly buys $69.5 million beach house in Miami
item.description: A record Golden Beach sale is reportedly linked to the Amazon founder, who already owns three waterfront properties in the area.
